---
title: "3D fold-up"
---

```{r}
#| label: setup-fold3d
#| include: false
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(forcats)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
})
library(DT)
glue_path <- "../data/bowser/fold3d-glue.csv"
glue <- if (file.exists(glue_path)) read_csv(glue_path, col_types = cols(number = col_character()))
```

The fold-up prototype (`make -f fold3d.mk`) folds the traced pieces along their score lines and
glues them edge to edge, the way the paper model is built. Each glued edge gets the gap left
between the two sides in the folded model. A small gap means the traced outlines, folds and
edge numbers agree in 3D, not only on the sheet. The folded model itself is not shown here:
like the traced sheets, it is the creator's pattern.

```{r}
#| label: fold3d-summary
#| output: asis
if (is.null(glue)) {
  cat("The fold-up has not been run yet (data/bowser/fold3d-glue.csv is missing).\n")
} else {
  closed <- glue |> filter(status %in% c("closes", "proposed, closes"))
  cat(sprintf("%d glued edges: %d close (median gap %.1f mm), %d were let go while building, %d were proposed by shape only.\n",
              nrow(glue), nrow(closed), median(closed$gap_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
              sum(glue$status == "let go while building"),
              sum(glue$status == "proposed by shape only, not glued")))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: fold3d-gaps
#| fig-cap: "Gap between the two sides of each glued edge in the folded model (log scale)."
if (!is.null(glue)) {
  glue |>
    filter(!is.na(gap_mm)) |>
    mutate(status = fct_infreq(status)) |>
    ggplot(aes(pmax(gap_mm, 0.05), fill = status)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 40) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(closes = "#1a9e8f", `proposed, closes` = "#2DD2C0",
                                 `let go while building` = "#d61f69",
                                 `proposed by shape only, not glued` = "#FAC55B")) +
    labs(x = "gap (mm)", y = "glued edges", fill = NULL) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "top")
}
```

## Edges that do not close

```{r}
#| label: fold3d-table
#| column: page-right
if (!is.null(glue)) {
  glue |>
    filter(!status %in% c("closes")) |>
    arrange(desc(gap_mm)) |>
    mutate(status = factor(status)) |>
    datatable(
      rownames = FALSE, filter = "top", class = "compact stripe",
      colnames = c("Number", "Piece", "Tab piece", "Length", "Length diff", "Gap", "Look-alike", "Status"),
      options = list(pageLength = 25)
    )
}
```
